assignmentBackend: Original Ultralytics no-grad TaskAlignedAssigner on CPU; model forward/backward on MPS to avoid dense advanced-indexing failure.
selection: Highest validation mAP50-95 checkpoint; no test inference until model and confidence threshold are fixed.
confidenceSelection: Validation count-MAE minimum among [0.05,0.10,0.15,0.20,0.25,0.30,0.40,0.50], ties favor higher threshold.
testProtocol: Single whole-image evaluation at trained resolution; IoU0.50 detection matching, AP50/AP50-95, count MAE/RMSE/bias/exact-count rate. No test-driven retraining in this run.
trainingPurpose: Initial research candidate for colony counting, not species diagnosis or a production-ready replacement.
